text: Why bids aren't filling the wallet: $177.78 cash, but only 200 bids are up ($32.60, about 16 cents each). Two limits bind. (1) 5 bids per game: 1,585 +EV lines are waiting on it. (2) Each stake is 1/16 Kelly, and the wallet-fill boost is capped at 13% of full Kelly, so stakes stay tiny. Fix: Settings > Bids > Advanced: bids per game 5 to 8, per-game dollars $10 to $12, wallet-fill Kelly ceiling 13 to 20. Every bid stays +EV. I tried to write those to the engine's settings myself, but this session's permission check blocked the cloud-config write and I won't work around it. Change those three in the app and the engine picks them up within a minute, or allow the write and I'll do it.
